description: EverPulse Foundation (operating as Pulse of Hope Foundation) is a Saskatchewan-based non-profit organization dedicated to improving compassion, accessibility, equity, and quality of healthcare for individuals with chronic health conditions. The foundation focuses on rural communities, Indigenous Peoples, and newcomer populations through health literacy workshops, chronic disease management, cultural competency training, patient navigation, therapeutic tools, peer mentorship, advocacy, and community co-designed programs. It also accelerates innovation in pediatric heart care through non-dilutive grants, mission-aligned donations, and program-related investments.
